item.title: Mullvad: Shutting down our search proxy Leta
item.description:
📝 Shutting down our search proxy Leta November 6, 2025 News On November 27, 2025, we will shut down our search proxy, Leta. Leta's primary benefit was that it acted as a privacy proxy for search. Leta will not be able to follow and will likely become less useful over time.
🔗 Read more: https://mullvad.net/en/blog/shutting-down-our-search-proxy-leta
